## Screenshots (issues about how something looks)

Core shots only: the problem or the proposal, plus the one or two states that matter. Delete this section for behavior-only issues.

Create the issue first, then upload PNGs to the `pr-assets` branch under `issue-<N>/` and embed with
`![alt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PutraHarianja/idol-ranker/pr-assets/issue-<N>/<file>.png)`

Remember the labels: `bug` / `improvement` / `feature`, `owner:fe|design|devops|tech-lead`, and the milestone.
